title: THE TRAP

floorplan.camera: from the Venice end of the dining car at standing height, looking its full length toward the kitchen

anchors.DINING CAR: a grand restaurant car, laid tables down both sides of a carpeted aisle
anchors.KITCHEN END: the far end, double doors with round porthole windows
anchors.VENICE END: the camera end, velvet curtains drawn on night glass
anchors.TABLE ROW: the nearside row of laid tables, white cloths and silver domes
anchors.LUGGAGE RACK: brass overhead racks running the car's length

cast.depth: mid-car, low on the carpet in the mesh bundle
cast.action: lies on his back inside the fallen baggage net mid-car, short of Akane's table — the mesh closed around him but open over his face and chest, his ash-grey greatcoat and tall peaked cap still on him, his blank oval face and two hollow black eyes visible through the squares, straining against the net, his lantern arm tangled at his side with the lantern dangling from its sleeve cord, still lit

cast.depth: near, seated at a laid table for one
cast.action: sits at a laid table for one on Lucy's side of the car with the replica at her throat on a black velvet ribbon, turning an untouched champagne coupe slowly by its stem with her right hand and her left resting on the table, watching the doors with a heavy-lidded, almost bored expression — she was the bait, and she is early for dessert
cast.gaze_target: the Grey Passenger, level and unbothered

cast.depth: foreground frame-left, braced at the aisle's edge
cast.action: grips the bundle's drag-ropes with both hands, hauling the trussed passenger across the carpet toward the kitchen doors, body leaned into the pull, one foot braced against a table leg
cast.gaze_target: the drag-ropes in her hands, eyes down

cast.depth: foreground frame-right, braced at the aisle's edge
cast.action: grips the bundle's drag-ropes with both hands, hauling the trussed passenger across the carpet toward the kitchen doors, weight thrown back, one foot stepped behind him, masked face turned toward the bundle
cast.gaze_target: the drag-ropes in his hands, eyes down

moment: The trap has sprung mid-action, everyone in motion. Dessert stands abandoned: the passenger's lunge tripped the release and the net took him mid-car, and now Lucy and Wyatt haul the bundled ghost across the carpet toward the kitchen doors while he strains against the mesh — then the chandeliers blast back on and the dining car sees its ghost caught. Exactly four figures in this frame — the passenger, Akane, Lucy and Wyatt, and that is the full frame.
environment: laid tables with white cloths, silver domes and guttering candles down both sides of the carpeted aisle; every table on Wyatt's side stands cleared and empty, chairs pushed in; swaying crystal chandeliers; night windows turned black mirrors; swaying coat hangers; a dropped dessert spoon glinting mid-aisle.
lighting: candle warmth guttering into a beat of true blackout, then the chandeliers blasting back on full — the passenger rim-lit and netted; the net's shadow striping the aisle carpet.
colour: full, rich colour — cream cloths, gold chandelier light, red carpet; the passenger ash-grey at the centre of it all.
negatives: menus, tickets and labels are blank unmarked cards
clean costumes, undamaged props and safe set dressing throughout
the passenger stays a costume: the rubber-hose hand is a costume detail
Akane watches with heavy-lidded calm, her hands busy in her lap or at her sides
Wyatt's hands are clean bare skin, his only tattoos the king and queen on his neck
Wyatt wears his black cardigan, white t-shirt and black cargo trousers, while the ash-grey greatcoat, peaked cap and lantern belong to the figure inside the net
